verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents its own controls that address part of this story. Relayed authorisation webhooks deliver transaction data, including transaction-rule and validation-check results, for a real-time approve/decline decision. Configurable transaction rules auto-decline non-conforming authorizations, 3D Secure (OTP/OOB) authenticates online transactions, and cards can be suspended or permanently closed. Missing for 10: network or Adyen fraud scores surfaced at auth time, proactive suspicious-activity alerts to ops, a documented reissue/replace-card flow for compromised cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
